newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Pearl says '96 results no better than '95.
newsitem.headline: Pearl says '96 results no better than '95.

text.p: Property developer Hainan Pearl River Enterprises Holding Co Ltd said on Tuesday surging stocks prices should not be linked to company results for 1996, which it said would be no better than the prior year.

"The firm's property sale in Shanghai was not bad but overall business was not ideal," a company spokesman told Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin when asked about the sale of Pearl's 400-million-yuan Shanghai Zhujiang Rose Garden.
Brokers said sales of the 100,000-square-metre complex in Pudong lifted Pearl to top performer on Tuesday on the B share market.
Pearl River's B shares closed at HK$3.70, up HK$0.25 or 7.25 percent on active trade of 3.74 million shares.
"The company is unlikely to report a loss for last year," the spokesman said but gave no details.
Pearl River's 1996 interim net was 4.21 million yuan against 30.01 million yuan in the year-earlier period. Net profits for 1995 were 5.17 million yuan compared with 169.32 million yuan in 1994.
